name: roadalert-monorepo
description: RoadAlert — Intelligent Traffic Incident Verification & Response Platform (Nexathon 26)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
